queue.title: today's Glide Pack was very rewarding for me.
queue.body:
The feeling after opening the Glide Pack is really a different kind of excitement. Because you don't know in advance what is inside each pack, which card will be drawn. The greatest joy lies in this uncertainty. The five cards I got by opening the Glide Pack today are not just ordinary collections, but also an important addition to my gaming journey. The cards are Krash Wanderford (Gold), Alfredo (Rare), Isgald Vorst, Chimney Wallstop and Witch of Warwick. Each card has its own unique characteristics, strength, practical aspects and future prospects. I will talk in detail about the experience of opening this pack, the analysis of the cards, and my personal feelings.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWpGZ7VEctc3k7P2u6UzuRHoBFncHMD7Yh3BwZkp4EPCx/1776991363861.jpg)

The first card that caught my eye was Krash Wanderford Gold. Getting a gold card when opening any pack means a different excitement. Because gold cards are usually attractive to look at, have a high rarity value, and play an important role in the gameplay in the future. Krash Wanderford's mana cost is 4, which is medium quality. It means not too heavy, but not too light.  With Attack 7 and Speed ​​7, this card is great for offensive style. Such a card can hit quickly and put the opponent under pressure. Although the Health is relatively low, the speed and attack compensate for it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiK89e5cjHhBeqntuVhzgxdkP2AHqZQdEVgUeV6EToYZ/1776991363751.jpg)

 Although there are two abilities at the beginning, new skills are unlocked as the level increases. In the screenshot I saw, the level progression is very nicely arranged. The estimated power starts from level 3 and goes up to 2000 power at level 10. This means that this card is not only great in present value, but also as a future investment. I personally think that Krash Wanderford Gold is the most valuable drop in my collection.

The second card is Alfredo (Rare). Rare cards mean a little more importance than common cards. Alfredo's mana cost is only 2, which makes it a great option in low mana battles. Attack 1, Speed ​​2, Health 4 – these stats may not seem very impressive at first. But in low mana matches, cheap cost cards often turn the tide of the match.  Because when the mana limit is low, heavy cards cannot be used. At that time, cards like Alfredo are effective.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRMMwSRBdPEcwPc54fAQ2qk6w7ZWDnzQCyke8qy3o9qX/1776991363651.jpg)

Due to its rare rarity its value may increase in future. Leveling up can improve stats well skill utility. I think Alfredo is a card that may seem small at first, but can strategically win many matches.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSYiv56bi8UXRKJEixM2qeLdALRcDirsM37yoFWnN1SGb/1776991363920.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeJjEwDeebbNmrc1bUP4xkgetunRjRdNLaPMk6XypjNzZ/1776991363540.jpg)

The third card is Isgald Vorst. Such a card usually works wel a support fighter. That means it can be used behind the frontline tank to deal steady damage.

Isgald Vorst's design is also great. The warrior style appearance with shield and sword makes it visually powerful. Sometimes, not only stats, but card design is also important for a collection. Because a beautifully designed card adds a different beauty to a collection. I think this card will give good results if used in a strategy-based lineup.

The fourth card is Chimney Wallstop. This card gives a heavy warrior vibe at first glance. 

Ideal for keeping in the frontline due to its high health and armor.  Although the speed is low, it is not a big problem for tank cards. Because its job is not to hit quickly, but rather to absorb damage and last for a long time. Since it has Attack 5, it can also give good damage to the opponent if it gets the chance.

I personally like high mana battles, because big cards can be used there. Chimney Wallstop can provide extraordinary value in that type of battle. If it can be paired with a healer or support card, it will become even more powerful.

The fifth card is Witch of Warwick. This card gives a slightly different vibe than the other cards. The purple background and mystical design present it as a magic-based card. Mana cost 5, Magic attack 2, Speed ​​1, Health 2. Although the stats are not very defensive, magic attack is always important. Because magic damage can often bypass armor.

It works well if you put such a card in the backline. The tank card in front will absorb damage, and Witch of Warwick will launch magic attacks from a safe distance. I think this card will be very useful in a strategy lineup.  Especially when the opponent uses heavy armor, magic cards are very effective.

Analyzing these five cards together, it can be seen that my pack drop is quite balanced. Here is gold premium attacker, rare cheap utility card, balanced fighter, heavy tank, and magic support. That is, I got cards of different roles from one pack. Many times when you open a pack, the same type of useless card comes out more, but that was not the case here.

This is a big step forward in terms of my collection. Because now I have more options when building my lineup. Alfredo in low mana battles, Krash Wanderford or Isgald Vorst in medium battles, Chimney Wallstop in high mana battles, and Witch of Warwick as support.

The most exciting thing is Krash Wanderford Gold. The prestige of gold foil cards is always different. Many players look for gold cards not only for gameplay, but also for collection value. For me, this drop made the whole pack opening experience special.

When the first card is revealed during pack opening, there is a tension. One card after another starts appearing, and the player thinks – what will I get now? When a gold card is seen, the excitement doubles. Today, that happened to me too.

Many people think that pack opening is pure luck, but I think patience is also important here. If you open packs regularly, your collection will gradually build. Not all packs will have legendary or gold, but sometimes such drops bring back the full motivation.

 What I learned from this pack is that every rarity card has value. Not just legendary or gold, rare or common cards can also be game changers depending on the strategy. For example, Alfredo is important in low mana matches, Witch of Warwick is effective as an armor counter, Chimney Wallstop is strong as a tank.

As a future plan, I want to level up Krash Wanderford. Because looking at its progression chart, it is clear that the value increases rapidly as the level increases. Power increase, additional abilities, and gameplay impact – it is a card worth investing in from all aspects.

Then I want to build Chimney Wallstop for high mana battles. Because if you have a strong tank, the whole lineup is stable. Then Witch of Warwick can become more dangerous if you level up as a magic utility.

My collection is now much more versatile than before. Before, it might have been a problem in some battle formats, but now there are cards according to different mana caps. This is the main strength of a good collection – flexibility.

Another thing is market value. Gold and Rare cards can also be important for trading or selling in the future.  Although I am not thinking of selling now, because building a collection is my first priority. However, in the long term perspective, these can be valuable assets.

The experience of opening this pack reminded me again why card games are so addictive. There is strategy, excitement, reward, and collection pride. When a new powerful card is added to your inventory, there is a sense of accomplishment.

I think today's Glide Pack opening was successful for me. Because not only the rarity, but also the usability was good. Many times even if you get a gold card, it can be weak, and even if you get a strong card, the rarity may be low. But today the overall package was good.

Finally, if I give a personal ranking, then in my opinion:
1. Krash Wanderford Gold
2. Chimney Wallstop
3. Witch of Warwick
4. Alfredo Rare
5. Isgald Vorst

However, the ranking does not mean that the following cards are bad. Rather, each one has a different value according to the battle situation.

My motivation has increased even more after opening this pack.  Now I want to open more packs, collect more rare cards, make my lineup stronger. That's the real fun of card games - growing my collection little by little every day.

In short, today's Glide Pack was very rewarding for me. All five cards are useful, the collection is beautiful, and the gold drop made whole day memorable. I'm really happy with this pack opening I'm looking forward going into battle with these cards in  future.

queue.title: Modern Gold II Unlocked”
queue.body:
Splinterlands is not just a game for me now, it is like a special feeling in my daily life. Whenever I have some time at the beginning day in the middle a busy day, I enter this game. Because here there is not only the joy of winning battles, there is also planning, strategy, patience, experience and a different taste of self-improvement. Many people see games just entertainment, but for me Splinterlands is a place where I learn something new every day, test myself gain confidence to move forward step by step. The position I have reached today, unlocking Modern Gold II League, is not just a rank for me—it is a symbol my hard work, patience and consistency.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTcMJvqD832V3MJHy7SwedKMhLCr1q5oCk3CMqwb588rk/1776899797794.png)

When I first started playing Splinterlands, everything was not so easy. I could not win every match many times I chose  wrong cards used the wrong strategy, did not understand the opponent moves. But that is the real beauty this game. Even if you lose, there is an opportunity to learn. I learned  understand which team to use in which rules, which card is more effective in which mana cap, which Summoner Monster can turn the match around in which situations. Gradually, I realized that Splinterlands is not just a game  war—it is a game thinking, a game patience, a game making  right decisions.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcwrc7AakHouiXstLFgUmYd6p6C3QmVhbjBap5Qa6gKj8/1776899797987.jpg)

When the words “Modern Gold II Unlocked” appeared on my screen today, I honestly felt a strange joy in my chest. Because behind this achievement are countless matches, wins and losses, playing all night, changing strategies, upgrading cards, and constantly trying to improve myself. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYnGnaYFM7DzL3qhPB2PUfFRXNH6ZmUetMknPRLB2FNQN/1776899797923.jpg)

The gifts I have received for reaching  position are very valuable me. Because they are not just rewards, they are recognition of my hard work. The Merits that I received in the first place are very important. Merits in Splinterlands are a resource that can be used to purchase special Gladius Packs from the Guild Store. These Gladius cards are incredibly effective in Brawl battles.  As a result, the more Merits I can accumulate, the more powerful cards I can collect. This means that my contribution to future Guild Wars will increase. So these Merits seem like a future strength to me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9i1bNWMrbiPNoXLNbn8Xs9U9Qn1b2Q8Hrfy3a1PBZb8/1776899798286.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVXRGC47j2L1tUGSC3psund3aCBgvSrEpWnQfU8Z2rfJ/1776899798126.jpg)

Then getting the Legendary Potion Charge is also a great joy. Because using Legendary Potion increases the chances getting a Legendary Card when opening a new Pack. Legendary cards in Splinterlands mean a different status, power, and often decisive role in the match. So this Potion Charge is a kind hope for me. Maybe when opening a Pack in future, luck will smile at me and I will get a card that will make my entire deck stronger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFMNJGKCc8wkkic9KPZh18A9WGDNgyQEypqP9Xmd7a3j/1776899926604.jpg)

The Alchemy Potion Charge is also very useful. It increases the chances of getting a Gold Foil Card. The Gold Foil card is not only beautiful to look at, but it also has a high financial value and often provides additional benefits in Battle or Reward. So this Potion Charge is like an investment in the future for me. Because getting a Gold Foil card is not only a matter of pride in collecting, but it can also provide good returns in the future.

I also got Scrolls, which are very valuable in the current system. Scrolls are usually used for various development purposes and bring new opportunities. If you save them you can use them for special upgrades crafting other purposes in future. So even though they look small they are very valuable.A regular player knows that even small rewards can eventually turn into big power.

Getting Energy is also a great thing for me. Because with Energy you can play more matches, earn more rewards, and maintain the continuity game. Sometimes, when Energy decreases, you have stop playing even if you want to. So getting Energy as a reward means an opportunity start fighting again with new enthusiasm.

Getting a card in Reward is one of the most enjoyable parts. Because every new card means new possibilities. Maybe a card wasn't in my deck before, now it will open up new strategies. If you get an extra copy an old card, you can Level Up and make it stronger. In Splinterlands, cards are not just collectibles, they are the foundation a player.

Seeing today's Reward Screen, I felt that hard work is never in vain. 

 Splinterlands sometimes feels like a reflection of real life to me. Just as planning is needed here, so is real life. Just as making mistakes here means losing, so does paying the price for mistakes in life. Just as trying repeatedly here means succeeding, so does life. So this game not only provides entertainment, it teaches a lot mentally.

I believe that those who give this game time and study hard will definitely understand its beauty. From the outside it may seem like it just a card battle. But when you go inside, you can understand that there is economy, community competition opportunities for self-improvement.

I have carefully looked at each reward I received today. Because these are not just numbers to me. 88 Merits, 163 Merits, 633 Merits—these are the calculations of my struggle. Potion Charges are my future potential. Scrolls are my future preparation. New cards are an increase in my power. And this entire Reward Package is a symbol of honor for me.

 

I don't want stop this journey mine. I will learn new things every day, play better build stronger decks climb higher leagues. Because Splinterlands is not just a game anymore, it is my addiction my joy my daily motivation. Today's reward and achievement have given me new strength. Even greater success awaits ahead—I am ready for it.

queue.title: I had opportunity open a few guild packs
queue.body:
Today was a very happy day for me because today I had opportunity open a few guild packs again. Those who play the game regularly know very well that opening a guild pack is always an exciting thing. When opening each pack, there is a different kind of curiosity in the mind—what kind of cards might be inside, whether there will be a rare or powerful card, or whether there will be a card that will be very useful in the future battles.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTFHvyhtRvFRE9waHGWcFj6WKmRKhqfwkykTUkWjBg4f/1773363590869.png)

The most interesting thing when opening a guild pack is the uncertainty. You can never say for sure what is inside the pack. Sometimes you get ordinary cards, and sometimes you get some cards that are really valuable and useful. That is why opening a pack every time feels like a small adventure.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcX1YkYdCBXZQn9stGRS6x5QTph3YCQaskHYQLuLW3hr8/1773363412919.jpg)

When I was opening the packs today, several cards came to the fore at the beginning. we can see a few different types cards, such Whistling Damon, Isgald Vorst, Witch Warwick, Chimney Wallstop, and Ajax Lightfoot. Each card has its own characteristics strengths that can be useful in different situations in game.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZadaT63KZvX1tHsdEeHPPVajX8C3zJ2sBGqyQ2QmPSP/1773363412844.jpg)

 Whistling Damon is a great card, especially when using low mana. Sometimes the mana cap is low in a match and then such cards become very important. You can easily create a balanced team using such cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4YfCFYvWXwiyWHgjQ3vrFaH5RXXSxcjhEk3X9Fja6Lw/1773363412793.jpg)

Then there is Isgald Vorst. This card is known to many players and has a very strong attack power. Using this card in the right position can quickly put pressure on the opponent. Especially if the support card is good, then this card can turn the tide of the match.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUS7sMftxGq7mEBXXFiskou5cyDgzU2yejaBUfzWmYq8e/1773363412710.jpg)

The Witch of Warwick card is also quite interesting. Such magic-based cards often become very important because magic attacks can directly hit the opponent's health. So even if the opponent uses a lot of armor, magic attacks can still weaken him.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYimMft4pZK3o3Zn78rbMzDj7eHLwnZdkrdNc9EhLjD3k/1773363412628.jpg)

Then we see Chimney Wallstop. Although this card has a little more mana, its power and durability are very good. In matches where there is a large mana cap, it is very convenient to use such powerful cards.

 Another important card is Ajax Lightfoot, which is a rare card. Rare cards are always a joy to get. Because they are often more effective than common cards and can become even more powerful if upgraded in the future.

In the next picture, we can see another set of cards—Captain Katie, Palidon Rakk, Hugo Strongsword, and Helmet Kharafax. These cards also have some very important cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYimMft4pZK3o3Zn78rbMzDj7eHLwnZdkrdNc9EhLjD3k/1773363412628.jpg)

Captain Katie is a rare card and is quite popular with many players. When used correctly, it can hit the opponent very quickly and have a big impact on the match.

Palidon Rakk is another rare card, which has quite good power and health. This type of card is usually used in the front because it can withstand quite a lot of damage.

Hugo Strongsword, as the name suggests, is a strong fighter-type card. Such cards are usually good at melee attacks and can quickly weaken the cards in front of the opponent.

Finally, there is Helmet Kharafax. Although its mana is low, this type of card can also play an important role in the right situation.

 Another thing I really liked when opening this pack is that I was able to open the guild pack using a few merit points. These merit points can be collected by fighting and contributing regularly as a guild member. So being active in the guild is always profitable.

I always try collect different types cards while playing  game. Because the more cards you have, more strategies you can use. Sometimes specific card in particular match can change outcome entire match.

Another big advantage of opening a guild pack is that sometimes you can get very valuable cards that can be sold very good price in market. Although my main goal is enjoy  game using cards, sometimes it gives different pleasure when you get a good card.

This whole experience reminded me again why I love this game so much. It's not just about fighting, but also a mix collecting, strategy luck. There is a possibility getting something new every day and that makes the game more interesting.

The experience opening pack today was really satisfying for me.  Although I didnt get many legendary cards I got a few rare useful cards which will definitely come handy future matches.

I hope collect more merits in future and have the opportunity  open new guild packs again. Then there may be a chance get rarer and more powerful cards.

All in all, today will be a beautiful experience in my gaming journey. The excitement opening a guild pack, the joy of getting new cards, and plans use them in future—it was a moment truly enjoy.

I always believe that if you play patiently try regularly, one day you will definitely get better cards. So I will continue my journey  hope gain many more new experiences in  future.

One by one, the cards started to appear on the screen. At first, they were all on the back—that mysterious blue design, what was hidden inside was still unknown. Then when it was revealed, I was really surprised. Getting so many rare cards at once—this is a big deal for me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmugxGgmGrAqen8wHp9rb4pH24kMJfrPgAahxCkZ24ez/1777606034987.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGgm9e1zwwY85qGu3gjerLSMDG4eHEwu1nqWLBoQVnA7/1777606068732.jpg)

Another one that really caught my attention was “Pixie-Knife Hurler”—this card also came twice. The joy of getting a duplicate is different, because it will help me strengthen my deck in the future. Then there was “Anchor-Hex Adept”—I really liked both the design and the power of this card.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ8u6B8gUrwDqCDP1moeaWDdPHL8sNgfbscDzREDKPzEW/1777606068572.jpg)

The last card I got was “Swampwrought”—an Elemental card. When I saw this card, I thought it could be very important for my deck. Because Elemental cards usually bring special powers, which when used at the right time can change the outcome of the game.

The whole experience for me was not just limited to getting the card. It was a feeling—an anticipation, an excitement, a moment joy.I saw all  cards together it really felt like my hard work had paid off.I have now realized  value tokens I have accumulated over  years.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbM2BdkJkFedg6RktCdp43xqyey32BRGnMWr4Gpf6BCLQ/1777606068666.jpg)

Moments like these what make gaming special. The real joy game is not in winning losing but in these small successes, unexpected gains testing your luck. Todays rare draw is just such an experience for me.

I know that I may get something better in the future, maybe even a gold foil one day. But today's draw has a special place in my heart. Because it was not just a pack open it was a result my patience, planning anticipation.

today will be a memorable day in my gaming life. I am inspired  this experience play better, create more strategies, and of course, hope get such a great draw again.

Finally, I will say one thing - as important as luck is in the game, your patience and planning are equally important. And when these two work together, such beautiful moments are created, which I experienced today.

queue.title: Splinterlands Ranked Battle Report: Another memorable victory in Gold II with great strategy
queue.body:
Today, I achieved a remarkable victory in the Modern Ranked match of Splinterlands, which not only increased my rating but also was a successful implementation of my strategic plan. The match was challenging from  beginning opponent lineup was quite strong and full of various offensive and defensive cards. However, with right team selection, positioning and decision-making according  the battlefield situation, I was able  snatch victory in the end.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxWf3KmVkMi6kUi7kKjNprx2dbbcG9KhrpgWj1smMYob/1781252699163.png)

At the beginning  match, when I arranged my team, I first tried analyze the opponents possible strategy. With a 75 mana cap, both sides had the opportunity use powerful monsters. So, it was not only important use powerful cards, but also create right combination between them. I selected a team that had a balance between tanks supports and damage dealers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4FDW2XPt9YUhuY1BG6XXfwwUwDF2wqNGhidEfYJN7bL/1781252375249.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCnwVkSjLac7ZBcJA3RDSTUTDcEMpLmJCz2aNoZRE2PJ/1781252375012.jpg)

In the front row, I used a powerful tank that could withstand enemy attacks for a long time.  In Splinterlands, it often happens that when front line monsters are destroyed early on whole team collapses. So my goal was have a card in first position that would absorb the opponents attacks and keep important units in the back safe. My tank did a great job that.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzZpDF7eAfBGGwZkmtZeEY9PvbRBJ2JEZZKibsoWXiQ6/1781252374692.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeHnEuFc7A6fCSQPq6h81GeDJZNevjC5kyA7mcNVp22RX/1781252374864.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ22YzLpuwx8A3uGPZPpBMR2xh67FXwjf8G7ghL47zPEw/1781252375146.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWSAWFjFqWmc7wXp4tJtFa8gxRP7zKQD5E5BXnEP8FNL8/1781252406151.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMeTYwJYzdc19QPvYNavKaWfNDpdp6FBLvDWQQdGDSoA/1781252406247.jpg)

The mid-line units were my main strength. They consistently put pressure on the enemy team and attacked the opponent's important monsters. Especially the fast-attacking units put the opponent in trouble. Although some of the opponent's monsters were strong, they could not cope with my continuous attacks.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXyzoa2CpqFqfCFwesxFLGb2NTm8VzMSYLXq3zjkSXqx2/1781252406044.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPMSPayaSYu6dPiy3Mvf6JoMyNFQfUFTzbeR94BQ9Tb1/1781252406393.jpg)

It was clear from the first round  battle that the match would not be easy. Both sides put their best cards on the field. Although the fight was somewhat even at first, my strategy gradually began work. My team targeted  opponents main offensive units and reduced their strength.the opponent's damage output decreased significantly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYroP3mcQ1FNmVksxAcGTS1Cd6EGJ3yv5tceHV2bj7Dc/1781252406496.jpg)

A key moment in the match was when my team's support units used their special abilities increase their overall performance.  In Splinterlands, not only attacks, but also buffs, debuffs, and other special abilities play a key role in winning. The support cards I used did just that. They increased the team survivability and weakened the opponent's strategy.

The opponent's team had a few dangerous monsters that could have turned the match around. But they were quickly weakened by the coordinated attacks my units. Especially the targeted attack strategy put opponent under pressure. Losing important monsters one after another upset their team's balance.

As the battle progressed, my team's confidence grew. At one point, it was seen that several important cards  the opponent had left the field, while the main units of my team were still alive. That's when I realized that control the match was gradually shifting into my hands.

In the middle the match, my tank still held its position firmly, which created a huge advantage for the entire team. The damage dealers in the back were able to continue their work safely. Such protection in Splinterlands often made the difference between victory and defeat.

 my teams strengths was patience and consistency. While the opponent tried get quick results I followed a long-term plan. In each round, my team gradually built up an advantage and used that advantage  maintain control the match.

Towards the end, the opponents situation became very fragile. They were unable  mount an effective defense due  the loss their important attackers and support units. On the other hand, several units on my team were still in working order. As a result, victory was almost certain.

When the last opponent monster was finally defeated, the desired "Victory" message appeared on the screen. It was a very satisfying moment. This victory was achieved as result  long planning, correct card selection, and strategic decisions.

With this victory, I was able establish  stronger position in the Gold II League. At the end the match, I earned 20 rating points 250 Glint 2,012 SPS rewards. These rewards will play an important role in future progress.

The most enjoyable thing is that this match once again proved that Splinterlands is not just a game strong cards;  It is essentially a game strategy, planning, and good decision-making. Sometime even a relatively strong opponent can be defeated plan.

I learned  few important lessons from today match. First, the balance team composition is very important. Second, you should not rely only on offensive power, but also on support and defensive power. Third, preparing in advance anticipating the opponent's possible strategy  determines the outcome  match.

Overall, this was one the best Ranked Battles I have played in recent times. I enjoyed every moment match and was able achieve a great victory in the end. This victory in the Gold II League has increased my confidence and inspired me  do better in future matches.

I hope play many more difficult and exciting matches in future. Every match teaches me something new and makes me more skilled as a Splinterlands player. Todays victory is not just a simple victory, but a shining example patience, planning, and the successful implementation right strategy.

queue.title: The most interesting card the guild pack
queue.body:
Today I had a really great experience opening the guild pack. Every time I open a pack there is a different kind excitement, because you never know when card will come out. Opening the pack today was a lot fun for me, because I got some important and powerful cards that will be very useful in future battles. I especially enjoyed the whole thing more because I got some Rare and Epic cards.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcDgL2wd3UVsHYQBHDz6bPLBMZexgzj5tvFPaL6dpdejw/1779151898959.png)

The most interesting card I got in the first picture was Edith Emberstar. Since it is an Epic card, I was naturally more interested. This card has quite good attack power and the ability to hit the enemy from a distance can bring a big advantage in battle. Sometimes, having a good ranged unit behind a strong tank line can change the outcome of the entire match. I think Edith Emberstar is just such a card. If you use it in the right mana match, it will be possible to put pressure on the opponent.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH8Pv7JUbBLjSL8C26KZZDp9Q7RqZHs5SPQ9ouvXiETQ/1779151714399.jpg)

I was also very happy to get the Captain Katie card. As a Rare card, it is already popular with many players.  Looking at its magic attack and stats, it seems like it could be very effective for the mid lane. Especially in matches where the opponent has high armor, magic attack plays a big role. Because magic attacks can directly damage health. So I plan to use this card in some important battles in the future.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAj736ZBTn5hvRwFPjTjfP5puPzgdio5BEjDWpJRfuU5/1779151714754.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcm7zgXrKzVABXkbeJB3qa6UgC4jyS14LwYayJ8sP8ZEk/1779151714918.jpg)

I also like the Krash Wanderford card in the same picture. Its speed and attack power combined allow it to hit quickly. In some matches, speed is the key to winning. If you can attack before the opponent, it is often possible to easily take control of the match. So I think this card will be quite effective in low mana battles.

Then comes Hugo Strongsword. I have seen this card before and it always seemed like a balanced card. Attack, defense, and health—everything is fairly well balanced. Sometimes such cards help the most in battles because they can be used in different situations. It can also be used as a tank and can also be used as a support.  I was very happy to get this card again today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9xxHbTVzrYNKnRgChA3TnihZC1AC2ytMaASbXVTEkph/1779151714500.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVbNzLKWxL6E7YPcxgqEDCGk4pJ6W6XPkkjc43mfdcoxu/1779151714620.jpg)

Another card was Witch of Warwick. I found the design of this card very interesting. It looks a bit mysterious and gives a dark type feel. Although its stats are not very strong, it can be useful in the right combination. Especially if there is a rule set where less mana is used, then this type of card is very useful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNv8R4eRXv4DD6YvGSaQSGjX5mmY2TUJyCCGv1htx1Mpi/1779151764015.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuMGYcoY5k1DeWqw4287JLmD2FfqdM9NCMQJs8cNZw4p/1779151764109.jpg)

There were also some good collections among the cards in the second picture. The Katrella Gobson card seemed quite unique to me. Its attack power and special features made it seem like it would good for fast-paced battles. There are some cards that seem very ordinary first glance but perform exceptionally well in right team combination. I think Katrella Gobson could one such card.

Then there was Alva The Crusher. As name suggests, it is a very aggressive card. Since this card has both good health attack, it can be effective when used in the front line. Sometimes it becomes difficult survive in battle without a strong tank.  So it's always a good idea have such cards in your collection.

Hugo Strongsword is also found in the second picture. Although it can be annoying to get the same card multiple times, it is actually very useful. Because duplicate cards are needed to upgrade cards later. So I see it as an added advantage. If you can increase the level of this card in the future, its power will also increase a lot.

Among the rare cards, Orella Abadon seems quite interesting to me. Especially low mana matches, small but effective cards can sometimes turn entire match around. I always try to keep such cards in my collection, because each ruleset requires a different strategy.

Finally, there was Ajax Lightfoot. I really liked the speed and balanced stats of this card. It is a card that can create a nice balance between attack and defense. I think it will fit very well in a fast attack-based team. Especially if there is a speed bonus, this card will become more effective.

From today's guild pack opening, I realized one thing again—in addition to luck, patience is also very important in this game. You can't always get big or legendary cards, but small good cards also gradually build a strong collection. Each new card creates new possibilities for the future. You can't tell in advance when a card will win a match.

I personally enjoy the moment of opening a pack a lot. Because it has a kind of surprise. The feeling of seeing new cards on the screen is really different. That joy has increased even more with the Epic and Rare cards in today's opening. Now my goal will be to gradually upgrade these cards and use them in the right combination to achieve better results.

 today guild pack opening was quite successful and enjoyable for me.  The new cards not only enrich my collection but also give me the opportunity to create new strategies for future battles. I hope able play more great matches using these cards in the coming days and gradually be able build stronger decks.

queue.title: I opened 3 Glint Packs today small and got some great cards | Splinterlands Glint Reward Opening
queue.body:
Todays Splinterlands gaming session was quite enjoyable for me. I had been saving Glint for a long time, and today I decided to open 3 Glint Packs at once. The joy of getting new cards is always different, because each pack has a surprise. No one can predict when a Rare, Gold Foil, or a powerful card that will be useful in the future will come out. With that excitement, I started opening today's pack.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQk6myoYyAEnhkTV3gXDbaciRxByTaEi9teWw3ahECKGD/1783729832700.png)

First, I went to Mana Well and bought three Glint Packs using my saved Glint. While opening the packs, I felt that if I get at least one Gold Foil or a good Rare card today, the day will be truly worthwhile. I can say that luck was on my side today.

What I got from the first Glint Pack

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSfZPMhqmS24vq9mYV31NW9zU9AZRT7XihMor3PfwRTgx/1783729832790.jpg)

I got five cards after opening the first pack.  Among them were—

Helmet Kharafax

Katrelba Gobson (Gold Foil)

Cutter Brieze

Kotriphus Bayne (Rare)

Ajax Lightfoot (Rare)

The biggest surprise was the Gold Foil Katrelba Gobson. Getting a Gold card is always special feeling because not only are they worth collecting, but they also often give you extra advantages in game. I was really happy to get a Gold Foil at the beginning of the pack.

Also, Kotriphus Bayne and Ajax Lightfoot – these two Rare cards have also enriched my collection. They will also be useful for leveling up in the future.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxvKLRxgbfTGfSnAMiiYPj6zqDzq1qqzGsgNAgLkqECF/1783729832951.jpg)

Results of the second Glint Pack

Since the first pack was good, my expectations for the second pack were even higher. Opening the second pack, I got—

Kotriphus Bayne

Isgald Vorst

Captain Katie (Rare)

Krash Wanderford

Witch of Warwick (Rare)

It was really nice to get two Rare cards – Captain Katie and Witch of Warwick – in this pack.  Captain Katie is a powerful card known to many. And Witch of Warwick is also a good addition for the future.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3PiYn4U2fi3zu6Fc335FAPB2PaRkaNRiPvhr17Uv5VK/1783729832917.jpg)

In addition, Isgald Vorst and Krash Wanderford were also added to my collection as new copies. It is not bad to have multiple copies of the same card, because they can be combined later to increase the level.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZdBoHfK7Lzs3M2dRsU3oKDSaB1m75z2x7527QaH4euAh/1783729871120.jpg)

Received the third Glint Pack

Then I opened the third and final Glint Pack. From this pack I got—

Sarius (Rare)

Helmet Kharafax

Chimney Wallstop

Krash Wanderford

Isgald Vorst

I also got a Rare card in the last pack, which is Sarius. In addition, I will have the opportunity to combine some of the previous cards in the future to create more powerful versions.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmePKQSBu7fuQ66nkMHcRf5vMw12uH3eYBS37WCg2s6ogr/1783729832872.jpg)

My feelings about today's opening

Overall, today's three Glint Pack openings seemed successful to me. Especially getting Gold Foil in the first pack increased the joy of the entire opening several times.

 I personally enjoy such openings because each pack offers new possibilities. You never know when a card will be added to your collection or which card will play an important role in the future Battle. The real fun lies in this uncertainty.

Rare cards will also help increase my Collection Strength. At the same time, getting additional copies will make it easier to combine and create higher-level cards in the future. So I am never disappointed even if I get duplicate cards.

My personal assessment

I was most happy from today's opening to get Gold Foil Katrelba Gobson. This is undoubtedly the best achievement of the day. In addition, getting Rare cards like Captain Katie, Witch of Warwick, Ajax Lightfoot, Kotriphus Bayne and Sarius also strengthened my collection.

I got a total 15 cards from three packs including one Gold Foil and several Rare cards. In my opinion, this is satisfactory result.


Future plans

I play Splinterlands regularly and try to collect as much Glint as possible every day.  In the future, I plan to open many Reward Packs at once by accumulating more Glint. This not only increases the chances getting good cards, but also increases the joy opening.

My goal is not only collect new cards but also gradually strengthen my deck and perform better in Ranked Battle. I also want to combine the necessary cards and take them to a higher level.

Finally, I would like to say that today's 3 Glint Pack openings were really enjoyable for me. I am satisfied with getting Gold Foil card multiple Rare cards and several useful Common cards. I find this Reward System  Splinterlands very interesting, because every time I open a pack, I have the hope getting something new.

I hope that I will be able to accumulate more Glint and open bigger ones in the future. Then maybe more valuable Gold Foil, Epic, or Legendary cards will also be added to the collection. Today's achievement has encouraged my Splinterlands journey even more. I wish you all the best. I hope that your next Glint Pack opening will also yield great cards.  Everyone stay safe and enjoy playing Splinterlands.

queue.title: New Season, New League, New Goals – A Story of Taking Your Journey One Step
queue.body:
For me every new season is not just a game update it is a chance to prove myself again. I get really excited when a new season starts. I go into each season with a lot of enthusiasm remembering what I did well and what I did badly in the season. This season was no different. After playing a lot of matches and using the strategy I was finally able to make it to the Modern Gold I League.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrkeQiY3pKxGhotKf9sHYfasnzomkzUEnhJaZ3jPzg5L/1783041923856.jpg)

When I saw the message that said I was moving up to the Gold I League it felt amazing. Not every time I play the game do I win easily. Sometimes I win a matches in a row and sometimes I lose really badly.. I never give up. I always think that if I keep trying I will do well eventually. Making it to the Gold I League makes me believe this more.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmck3Vki1xQ7A7ARP4ZJtDn2YLHMvsq8fnXiBRjLpo8HBo/1783041924117.jpg)

Now that I am in a league things are going to be tougher. The other players are better they have strategies and each match is going to be harder. So it is not about having good cards I also need to plan carefully and be patient. I try to understand the rules of each match before I play. I pick my team carefully. Sometimes one small decision can change the match.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPZDDV6pNmeE2hmq2czS2DdxYrctdXWNQUdoLQ6t6SuQD/1783041924207.jpg)

The rewards I got this season are really cool. When I made it to the Gold I League I opened the boxes with rewards. Got some new cards, special items and entries. Getting a rare card was a big surprise for me. These special cards are important because they help me make teams for future matches.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSajEvXh3T3c1qqL4iANsN3swAgZRcf2JENjQc2vDjhrD/1783041924007.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSbm6dWmXQhCYevUnHz3pDU3gKUueZU9A7stdFQYoLthF/1783041924307.jpg)

I also got some rare cards, which are still really useful. Some people only care about the rare cards but I think all cards are important. In the situation any card can help me win. So I try to use all my cards and make them better over time.

The special items and entries I got are also really helpful. They give me a chance of doing well in future events and getting more rewards. Every small reward helps me get closer to my goals. So I do not take any reward for granted.

What I learned the most from my journey far is to be patient. There were times when I felt like I was not going to win.. I took a break made a new plan and tried again. This time I did well. Games are not just for fun they also teach me be patient make decisions and adapt new situations.

I am really happy about moving up league and I have set new goals for myself. I want do consistently this season get better cards and make my team stronger. I do not want to stop at this league. My goal is bigger. I want to get closer to it every day.

I know there are players ahead but that is what motivates me. When I work hard and do well it feels really good. So I see every match as a chance learn and get better.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPpRprc72R6bAN2D5NQhxuHJE4FmCNpkEUqKQU27fPgWP/1783041959265.jpg)

To do well ingame I need look at what I did wrong  try do next time. I think about my matches what I did badly how I can do better next time. This helps me get better all time.

The best thing about Splinterlands is that every season is a start. No matter how well or badly I did season I get to start again and prove myself. This always gets me excited and motivated to play.

Now that I am in the Gold I League I feel more confident. I think that with the plan and practice I can get even better in the future. It will not be easy. I am ready for the challenge. I want to learn much as I can and get as much experience as possible.

Finally this new season is not about my new rank it is a new beginning. I have started my journey again with goals, new dreams and a lot of enthusiasm. I hope to get cards make a stronger team and do better than before.

I believe that every small success helps me get closer my goals. So I want keep moving and enjoy every moment  game. There are more challenges, battles and chances to learn ahead. I want to play every match with my best and get a little better every day. That is my goal, for the season and my new journey has begun.

queue.title: Today Ranked Battle Experience Strategy, Patience Memorable Win
queue.body:
Today like every day, I took some time play a Ranked Battle in Splinterlands. Usually I try play a few matches every day, because playing regularly increases my experience and also allows me learn new strategies. From the beginning, I felt that this match would not be easy. Looking  opponents lineup I could understand that he had arranged team very thoughtfully. So, from  beginning, I had be very careful in choosing my cards and determining my positions.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWSqciGDMuHaPBUzTnCcRPS7xz7fi9SuTy2redcpjWEW/1783307576558.jpg)

I used the green Splinter in today's match. This Splinter is my favorite because it has strong tanks, good supports, and monsters that are good at attacking from the backline. I tried to create a combination so that my front row cards could last for a long time and the back row cards would be safe and gradually weaken the opponent's team.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbFQw7F6xd74PRjk5QEFJTWH9s6mg978Wn9dqq6GprZrw/1783307576855.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXknekAFvTm8j7jTs8NBM6gMbpuWu3PYr5CewZMzpdETK/1783307576704.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqBqgJxw1tDCbiP2FrBPFoyi9M7BaULpya1U7Gaz7bHy/1783307577032.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdqDiTWnfCZBS2PrDPMzxQNFktA3Hnhv6WZVj5aeqNfQY/1783307576418.jpg)

Before the battle started, I tried to get some idea of the opponent's possible strategy.  Although it is often difficult to predict which splinter the opponent will use, you can get some idea based on their previous match experience or league. That experience came in handy in todays match as well. I created  lineup that had good balance between offense  defense.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyh1L2xT6HnHR7GArj3TvAeQZQfZQW6cqsFndDzQZn7Y/1783307623073.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVgWDBcGLtePiFNarNdTo6St4tjEhWw7tKgUBrxBGYYy/1783307622932.jpg)

After match started monsters on both sides started attacking each other from the first round. The tension the match increased with each hit. My frontline tank was taking hits quite well at the beginning, which was an important part of my plan. Because I knew that if the tank could survive a few rounds, the monsters in the backline would be able to attack with their full strength.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbJAC6wduogEtdpLqUC6pJeUTo4btSHmHeZdt4vcz4TdQ/1783307623193.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9bSM5WzwKA7D6Q9ja5jePkeA1sAkrf7A3qUtkCtuuTq/1783307623283.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVa3txJcPWPpCvE5TCnksCQpC9f5VnRTJDDSFKNbeiwxr/1783307623357.jpg)

The opponent was also not one to give up easily. Because if I lost important cards in backline quickly whole strategy could have collapsed. But fortunately, the skills and positioning of the cards I chose saved me from that danger.

The picture of the match started to change with each round.  The opponent, who seemed very strong at the beginning, gradually lost their monsters one by one. I think biggest reason for this victory was my team's coordinated attacks and proper positioning. Sometimes having strong cards alone does not guarantee victory but placing cards in right place right time makes the real difference.

That is, every moment of the entire battle was exciting. What would happen in the end was not clear at the beginning. I like playing this type of battle the most, because something new can happen here in every round. Sometimes a small mistake can change the outcome of the entire match, and again, a correct decision can ultimately bring victory.

My confidence increased a lot towards the end of the battle. Then I realized that the match was under my control. After the opponent important monsters left the field one by one, my chances winning became stronger. Finally, in the last round opponent last monster was also defeated and the word Victory appeared on the screen in large letters. That moment was truly a joy.

 With this victory, I also gained ranking points and received Glint and SPS rewards. Because by using them, it is possible to collect better cards in the future and make your deck stronger.

Todays match reminded me  an important thing again—Splinterlands is not just a game luck. Patience, planning, experience, and the ability understand your opponent decisions play a big role here. Sometimes, even with the same cards completely different strategies can yield completely different results. So there is an opportunity learn something new from every match.

I always try learn from every defeat and every victory. Because every match takes me forward on the path becoming a more skilled player. From todays match, I also realized how important it is to have faith in your strategy. If I had worried unnecessarily in the middle or made the wrong decision when I had the opportunity change my plan, the result could have been different.

todays ranked battle was much more interesting and enjoyable for me. The excitement in each round, the strong resistance opponent, the successful implementation my plan, and the great victory in the end—all of this combined will be one the best experiences the day.

I hope be able to play more competitive matches like this in the future and learn something new from each match and improve my gameplay. The biggest attraction  Splinterlands that every match offers new challenges new strategies experiences.Todays victory has made me more confident and inspired me perform better in upcoming matches.

The biggest feature of Molten Ogre is its strong attack and a good amount of Health. That is, it not only has the ability to hit, but also to withstand damage.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmacPx7KjffXNwmStb1MwsMz3qo3Ppgy7WTyQeZTWHgwvk/1785118286934.jpg)

Why did I buy Molten Ogre?

Before buying a new card, I always consider a few things. You should not buy a card just by looking at the price. You need to look at:

How effective is the card?

Will its use increase in the future?

Will it fit into my current deck?

How much will it improve if I increase its level?

In the case of Molten Ogre, I have seen that it is a card whose power increases a lot as it improves.  As the level increases, its Attack Power, Speed, and Health increase. 
Card Strengths and Weaknesses

Every card has some good points, but also some limitations. Molten Ogre is no exception.

Strengths

First, its Attack Power is very good. The ability to hit hard during battle is a big advantage. Especially when the opponent has weak units in front of them, Molten Ogre can quickly defeat them.

Second, its Health is quite good. The problem with many offensive cards is that they can do a lot of damage but cannot last long. In the case of Molten Ogre, this problem is somewhat less.

Third, its Ability gradually makes it more effective. When used with the right rules and the right team combination, it can change the outcome of the battle.

Weaknesses

However, like all cards, it also has some limitations.  It may not be equally effective in all types of battles.

In addition, because it is a powerful card, its Mana Cost can sometimes be high. As a result, it can be difficult to use it in low Mana battles.

A good player knows when to use which card. Not only does having strong cards ensure victory, the right strategy is also important.

My battle experience

The thing I like most after using Molten Ogre is its presence. After it enters the field, it feels like a strong warrior has been added to the team.

Especially when the opponent has strong units in front, Molten Ogre can survive for a long time using its health and gives the units behind a chance to attack.

In my opinion, this is a card that will not win the entire match alone, but can become an important part of the match if it is with the right team.

When building a good team, it is not enough to just have attacking cards. You need cards that can attack as well as handle pressure. Molten Ogre can play that role.

 Future Potential

I think Molten Ogre can be a good investment not only for current use, but also for the future.

The most important thing about card games is that the value of cards changes over time. A card that seems ordinary today may become very important in the future due to a new rule, new ability, or new strategy.

A powerful Fire Unit like Molten Ogre can be used in various combinations in the future.

Especially for those who want play the game a long time, it is important collect cards that have the potential improve.

My personal opinion

For me, Molten Ogre is not just a card, it is a new power in my game collection. The joy of buying a good card is different, especially when you know that it will be useful in your future gameplay.

I think that Molten Ogre is a card worth considering for those who like Fire Splinter and are looking for a strong Frontline unit.

However, I always think that before buying a card, you should understand your own playstyle. You should not buy a card just because someone else is using it. You should decide according to your deck, strategy and goals.

Final words

Finally, I would like to say that Molten Ogre is a good addition for me. Its strong attack, good health and future potential made me satisfied with the decision to buy this card.

A good card is not only valuable for its current power, but also how useful it will be in the future. In my view, Molten Ogre is a card that can become a terrible weapon in the hands of the right user.

I hope this card will perform better in future battles and strengthen my deck.  My interest in the game grows with each new card collection, and Molten Ogre is an important addition to my journey.

queue.title: Hexagonia tenuis
queue.body:
A beautiful form of fungus growing on a dry branch of a tree. Just looking at this picture shows how diverse the beauty of nature can be. It is probably a fungus called whose scientific name is Trametes versicolor. Its structure looks a lot like the tail a peacock a wild turkey, which is why the word tail is added to its name.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUPnnx54xERkanw4f21UkGepaakT5kzdmzXPCuweA6Avw/1754059436851.jpg)

In the picture, the fungi grow densely next  each other on the dry branch.  The arrangement of these color layers is spread in such a way that it looks like a carefully painted natural work  art. The circular lines like fine lines on the back of the fungi, as if time has left its own mark. Even the powdery or dusty lumps on them give the whole structure a real and living character.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwrx6XKMvhLcUJW5hr8JCQtggSotYSxsYA1nT6zg6Xnj/1754059437001.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV65t9YwDhp3QRQgPfTEaFFGNzyyN5eUmegnJRkKPhKrG/1754059437102.jpg)

 This type fungus usually grows on dead  decaying trees and acts as nature's cleaners. They decompose dead organic matter and return it the soil, so that new trees  plants can take nutrients from it. In this way, fungi act an important part the environment.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme7WgQ43vzXVasz14gvGYLvSEmAxQcQ9bKemUqgmV9ySK/1754059437225.jpg)

 The structure, lines, and even the dust particles on the fungus are clearly visible. Although the background is blurry, it can be understood that there are some more dry tree parts, which have created a suitable environment for these fungi live.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpy3Mka3cwCmBpsskjdBf39b7jrvWha67qEhAVXRrNpL/1754059437355.jpg)

The image can be an excellent example for biology students, because it gives an idea  how fungi develop in nature and what role they play in dead organic matter. It can also be educational in terms environmental awareness. Many us consider fungi  unnecessary or harmful, but this image shows us with our fingers that fungi are not just parasites, but are part the complete balance each environment.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9WHk27y68ah8ffBnWVtE8oQoAGMSRsRsnsJNVWdUxhw/1754059437472.jpg)

The structure, color, and fine prints on this fungus prove that nature is not only beneficial, but also an extreme example  art. Small fungi are placed together like a large work  art, if nature itself took a brush and created this design.

This type  image can be used in books  documentaries about natural history  biodiversity.  Artists often draw inspiration from nature this image can certainly  great inspiration for such an artist. Similarly, it is a wonderful capture from a photographer’s perspective—a perfect example  how small things can tell a big story.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfRDeu8wX9wFaUhVPBA9H8paYQ54ujbFu6LNMQnNovVK/1754059437603.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSn2wwP3TymMicgvmQc1g6QGeT9tDNgASMyJJGLqvzkbc/1754059437722.jpg)

This photograph is not just a picture  a fungus, it beautifully captures a part the vast, complex, and aesthetic cycle nature. It reminds us that even the smallest creatures in nature can be carriers immense beauty.

queue.title: Grasshawks
queue.body:
A beautiful butterfly-like brown dragonfly what many call a grasshopper in Bengali, is seen sitting on a leaf, surrounded by green grass and leaves. This type photo beautifully highlights the beauty and biodiversity nature.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMRhGVkw1YU2FjYzSKPV94b7bdyTzPy6cE7AR3kj369F/1754142996218.jpg)

Grasshoppers are beautiful insects that are usually seen around ponds, canals water bodies. However, the grasshopper in this photo is a little different. Its wings are thick brown and slightly opaque, making it quite attractive  look at. There is a fine line-like design between its wings, which is like a perfect work art in nature.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZpSiKJguKWwYPW1gDn26YR1QjCKYxwhhhKYq7xwniJES/1754142996336.jpg)

Grasshoppers are usually very fickle in nature. However, in the photo, this grasshopper is seen sitting calmly on a narrow leaf. Perhaps it is resting  observing prey around it. The grasshopper's eyes are very large and have almost 360-degree vision.  It can fly very fast and can turn suddenly in any direction, which is one its specialties.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQdiPvJ7aZbCff15fQhDRKuRNBvzrwowsKMKTDpP3NmNF/1754142996442.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHNkUFNxtDJVhzBpQ15T66tN5ZLbATZF7EofZNKjQnfB/1754142996798.jpg)

Such pictures also remind us the importance of nature conservation. Just as grasshoppers are an important part the environment, many other small and large animals are part our biodiversity. Grasshoppers maintain  balance environment by eating insects, especially playing an important role in controlling harmful insects like mosquitoes. Therefore sustain them, we should keep environment clean and reduce the use  chemicals.

The background of the picture is taken near natural forests. Where plants  grasses can grow effortlessly, and where small animals can live safely. The presence grasshoppers means that this place is still naturally healthy biodiverse.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBnEko9EjRSkC8bjWPCaNMvxoZc6HWefjPKVd5348yYK/1754142996958.jpg)

We have captured not a grasshopper, but a perfect moment of nature. Many may not be able to enjoy such scenes due to busy lives. But such pictures attract people to nature and teach them to think in a new way—how much we are a part of nature, and how important nature is to us.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7WvLn93CHfrptHDRBkZbY9KET7N7kQ4qQwiBhRBxkLE/1754142997061.jpg)

This picture helps us appreciate the beauty and diversity  nature.  This is not just  picture a simple grasshopper, but it carries  message—the more colorful nature is, the more we all have a responsibility  protect it. Love nature, give it time, and enjoy these small moments  nature.

queue.title: Oriental Forest Lizards
queue.body:
This photography captures a perfect fun moment in nature. In the picture, a chameleon lizard is hidden in a thicket leaves. It blends in very beautifully with the environment, which is called nature strategy — camouflage. Through this picture, we can learn about the amazing diversity nature wonderful survival strategies  animals.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVotupv47LtGDuJS1aCz1yJtqizUXw16hsBx2tezhuzyM/1754320963067.jpg)

The chameleon in the middle  picture is yellow-brown in color. It sits among the leaves in such a way that it is difficult find  glance. The chameleon body blends in with the color the leaves in such a way that it seems part  surrounding environment. This is one self-defense strategies animals. They can change their color  match environment avoid the eyes  predators. This is called camouflage.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUr4cZnHihmsBMgvXzLNQPKvMpEuL7QFgGwwe4GqGmwLj/1754320963216.jpg)

The picture shows plants full green leaves all around. Some dry stalks are hanging between the leaves, which are probably the fruits tree. The chameleon is sitting comfortably in branches this tree.  Its head is slightly raised, as if it is watching something waiting for prey. This is normal behavior for chameleons — they sit patiently and suddenly seize prey when they get the chance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQiZxa6X7vK5XoiynLzEdL58cmHGba7MhUhv8aRDMyFF/1754320963339.jpg)

It does not show a chameleon, but rather reminds  balance and biodiversity  nature. Animals like chameleons are an important part environment. They benefit farmers  eating insects sometimes they themselves become food for other animals. This cycle maintains the balance  nature.

queue.title: Splinterlands Ranked Battle Report: Another memorable victory in Gold II with great strategy
queue.body:
Today, I achieved a remarkable victory in the Modern Ranked match of Splinterlands, which not only increased my rating but also was a successful implementation of my strategic plan. The match was challenging from  beginning opponent lineup was quite strong and full of various offensive and defensive cards. However, with right team selection, positioning and decision-making according  the battlefield situation, I was able  snatch victory in the end.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxWf3KmVkMi6kUi7kKjNprx2dbbcG9KhrpgWj1smMYob/1781252699163.png)

At the beginning  match, when I arranged my team, I first tried analyze the opponents possible strategy. With a 75 mana cap, both sides had the opportunity use powerful monsters. So, it was not only important use powerful cards, but also create right combination between them. I selected a team that had a balance between tanks supports and damage dealers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4FDW2XPt9YUhuY1BG6XXfwwUwDF2wqNGhidEfYJN7bL/1781252375249.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCnwVkSjLac7ZBcJA3RDSTUTDcEMpLmJCz2aNoZRE2PJ/1781252375012.jpg)

In the front row, I used a powerful tank that could withstand enemy attacks for a long time.  In Splinterlands, it often happens that when front line monsters are destroyed early on whole team collapses. So my goal was have a card in first position that would absorb the opponents attacks and keep important units in the back safe. My tank did a great job that.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzZpDF7eAfBGGwZkmtZeEY9PvbRBJ2JEZZKibsoWXiQ6/1781252374692.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeHnEuFc7A6fCSQPq6h81GeDJZNevjC5kyA7mcNVp22RX/1781252374864.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ22YzLpuwx8A3uGPZPpBMR2xh67FXwjf8G7ghL47zPEw/1781252375146.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWSAWFjFqWmc7wXp4tJtFa8gxRP7zKQD5E5BXnEP8FNL8/1781252406151.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaMeTYwJYzdc19QPvYNavKaWfNDpdp6FBLvDWQQdGDSoA/1781252406247.jpg)

The mid-line units were my main strength. They consistently put pressure on the enemy team and attacked the opponent's important monsters. Especially the fast-attacking units put the opponent in trouble. Although some of the opponent's monsters were strong, they could not cope with my continuous attacks.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXyzoa2CpqFqfCFwesxFLGb2NTm8VzMSYLXq3zjkSXqx2/1781252406044.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPMSPayaSYu6dPiy3Mvf6JoMyNFQfUFTzbeR94BQ9Tb1/1781252406393.jpg)

It was clear from the first round  battle that the match would not be easy. Both sides put their best cards on the field. Although the fight was somewhat even at first, my strategy gradually began work. My team targeted  opponents main offensive units and reduced their strength.the opponent's damage output decreased significantly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYroP3mcQ1FNmVksxAcGTS1Cd6EGJ3yv5tceHV2bj7Dc/1781252406496.jpg)

A key moment in the match was when my team's support units used their special abilities increase their overall performance.  In Splinterlands, not only attacks, but also buffs, debuffs, and other special abilities play a key role in winning. The support cards I used did just that. They increased the team survivability and weakened the opponent's strategy.

The opponent's team had a few dangerous monsters that could have turned the match around. But they were quickly weakened by the coordinated attacks my units. Especially the targeted attack strategy put opponent under pressure. Losing important monsters one after another upset their team's balance.

As the battle progressed, my team's confidence grew. At one point, it was seen that several important cards  the opponent had left the field, while the main units of my team were still alive. That's when I realized that control the match was gradually shifting into my hands.

In the middle the match, my tank still held its position firmly, which created a huge advantage for the entire team. The damage dealers in the back were able to continue their work safely. Such protection in Splinterlands often made the difference between victory and defeat.

 my teams strengths was patience and consistency. While the opponent tried get quick results I followed a long-term plan. In each round, my team gradually built up an advantage and used that advantage  maintain control the match.

Towards the end, the opponents situation became very fragile. They were unable  mount an effective defense due  the loss their important attackers and support units. On the other hand, several units on my team were still in working order. As a result, victory was almost certain.

When the last opponent monster was finally defeated, the desired "Victory" message appeared on the screen. It was a very satisfying moment. This victory was achieved as result  long planning, correct card selection, and strategic decisions.

With this victory, I was able establish  stronger position in the Gold II League. At the end the match, I earned 20 rating points 250 Glint 2,012 SPS rewards. These rewards will play an important role in future progress.

The most enjoyable thing is that this match once again proved that Splinterlands is not just a game strong cards;  It is essentially a game strategy, planning, and good decision-making. Sometime even a relatively strong opponent can be defeated plan.

I learned  few important lessons from today match. First, the balance team composition is very important. Second, you should not rely only on offensive power, but also on support and defensive power. Third, preparing in advance anticipating the opponent's possible strategy  determines the outcome  match.

Overall, this was one the best Ranked Battles I have played in recent times. I enjoyed every moment match and was able achieve a great victory in the end. This victory in the Gold II League has increased my confidence and inspired me  do better in future matches.

I hope play many more difficult and exciting matches in future. Every match teaches me something new and makes me more skilled as a Splinterlands player. Todays victory is not just a simple victory, but a shining example patience, planning, and the successful implementation right strategy.

queue.title: My detailed experience with the cards obtained by opening the Glide Pack
queue.body:
Today I had the opportunity open Glide Pack in the game. One of the most enjoyable things in game is opening a new pack discovering what kind cards inside. Every time I open a pack I feel kind excitement. Because you never know when a valuable rare card will be found. This time was no exception. After opening the Glide Pack, I got several interesting cards which have enriched my collection and provided me with opportunity create more powerful decks in the future.

After opening the first pack, I got Goblin, Whistling Damon, Helmet Kharafax, Witch of Warwick and the Rare card Sarius. Each card has different characteristics and can be used in different types of strategic matches. When I turned over the first card and saw the Goblin, I immediately realized that it is a fast unit. Since it is a low-manner card, it is easy use at the beginning  match and sometimes such a card plays a very effective role in keeping opponent under pressure. Although it is a small card, its value is much higher if used at the right time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNgsYLrHf8iNCJobhqm88B6ZGcmLyiV9semF1fsrYjLH3/1781442827838.jpg)

 Then I got the Whistling Damon card. I really liked artwork and design  this card. Often, there are characters in game that are not only beautiful look at, but also contribute significantly to the battle. Whistling Damon seemed like just that to me. Considering its stats and power, it is suitable for moderate strategy use.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPT4j4KuEwAdbsYrVzZ5RRKuU6aY7LziGbpy2AzcuUerw/1781442827973.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpLZ1kTmXvuhq3Ut7cKs72B4aw7TSj8nWpS8fvtLNjkN/1781442990926.jpg)

After getting the Helmet Kharafax card, I have another good addition to my collection. The defensive properties of this card attracted me. In the game, it is not enough to have only offensive cards, but also strong defense is needed. Sometimes a good defensive card can change the outcome of the entire match. I think Helmet Kharafax is one of those potential cards.

Then comes Witch of Warwick. The look and design of this card are really amazing. You can tell just by looking at this card that the game developers have put a lot of effort into creating the artwork of the card. It is not only beautiful to look at, but the functionality of the card is also important. I believe that Witch of Warwick can play an important role in creating different types of decks in the future.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbxuBS7yUWGVSAns6U9kXxjGRbY3yVtyvRXNVQDGv63k7/1781442828420.jpg)

 But the most enjoyable moment of the first pack was getting the Rare card Sarius. The feeling of getting a Rare card is always different. When I saw the word Rare, I really liked it. Because Rare cards not only enhance the beauty of the collection, but also increase the player's strategic potential. Sometimes, new types of decks can be created with Rare cards, which are not possible with ordinary cards. After getting Sarius, I thought this pack was already successful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVVhT648XwLGgLeB72c4rLpyHYEATS8G7yJ9RKzecNLS1/1781442902312.jpg)

Then I opened the second Glide Pack. The second pack also had the opportunity to get several good cards. There I got Hugo Strongsword, Orella Abadon, Krash Wanderford and again Whistling Damon. The excitement was not less when opening the second pack. Because my hopes were even higher after getting the Rare card in the first pack.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQ4WwgUyj7cSurMuVpnJwKLLnuizGYfn7dxFaWm5m8nY/1781442902540.jpg)

The Hugo Strongsword card seemed quite strong to me. Both its attack and defense are balanced. The game always needs cards that can hit on one side, and hold their position on the other. Hugo Strongsword is exactly that kind of card. I plan to use it in different combinations in the future.

 Then came Orella Abadon. This was the second Rare card and the biggest surprise for me. It was really a blessing to get two Rare cards in one pack opening session. I really liked the design, character, and potential uses of Orella Abadon. All players love to collect Rare cards, as they increase the value of the collection and can provide an extra advantage in competitive matches.

The Krash Wanderford card is also an important addition to my collection. Just by looking its appearance it is clear that it aggressive character. Sometimes such a card is very effective for quickly attacking and pressuring the opponent. I think that Krash Wanderford can perform exceptionally well when used with the right deck.

Getting Whistling Damon a second time was also a positive for me. Because having multiple copies of the same card opens up the opportunity to upgrade or level up in the future. Many players try to collect multiple copies of a particular card so that they can make that card stronger. So I see getting Whistling Damon a second time as an added benefit.

The experience of opening these two Glide Packs has inspired me anew. The joy, excitement, and anticipation that comes with opening a pack every time in the game is truly amazing. Sometimes the desired card is not available, and sometimes, if luck helps, valuable Rare cards are added to the collection. This time, luck was quite good in my case. Getting two Rare cards and being able to collect several useful cards is undoubtedly a successful pack opening experience.

One of the fun things about playing the game is gradually enriching your collection. Each new card brings new possibilities. New cards mean new strategies, new decks, and new experiences. After opening this Glide Pack, I feel even more excited. Because my collection has added some cards that can help me in various battles in the future. 

Overall, today's Glide Pack opening was a very enjoyable and memorable experience for me. Goblin, Helmet Kharafax, Witch of Warwick, Hugo Strongsword, Krash Wanderford, Whistling Damon, Sarius and Orella Abadon—all of the cards have enriched my collection. I hope  open more Glide Packs in the future and collect new powerful and Rare cards. At the same time, I will be able improve my deck and achieve good results in competitive matches. queue.title: BUSY BEAVER
queue.body:
Today I am going to share a new and quite exciting experience in my gaming journey. I recently purchased a card called BUSY BEAVER (Rare Earth/Water Unit). The card caught my eye at first sight, and after using it I realized that it is not just an ordinary card—rather, if used correctly, it is a powerful unit that can turn  tide match.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc1tEnbSWN1ujB2jVTDuzp3bbNbQJB4QgGyHsfqbCEccn/1781934492796.png)

I will detail the card design stats level-up growth usage strategy strengths and weaknesses and my personal experience. I hope it will be helpful those who are thinking  buying using this card.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV5CfLba6EbybHepnF51pumsDaDSytzVSebj1UESBn2bj/1781934493181.jpg)

First Concept of the BUSY BEAVER Card

The BUSY BEAVER card is basically a “Mundane Beast” type unit. The artwork of the card shows  powerful beaver biting a tree with its teeth. Although it looks small its posture is very confident and aggressive. This visual design is what attracted me in first place.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBGgaWPh7GDiKQmQXXs23PUqXkdcUKFBiv48WgABJnag/1781934493259.jpg)

 In the game, many cards are usually attractive only with their stats, but in the case of BUSY BEAVER, both art and performance work well together.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmajUUkQ5A67UShVx4mGEciPzHhc3knwULAxgFmk68MPKw/1781934493078.jpg)

Stats Analysis

The base stats of this card are as follows:

Mana Cost: 6

Attack: 2

Speed: 2

Armor: 3

Health: 7

Looking at these stats, it may seem like a balanced tank/support unit at first. But in reality, it gradually becomes stronger, especially after leveling up.

Important points:

7 Health gives it the ability to survive

3 Armor blocks some damage at the beginning

With a cost of 6 mana, it is not very heavy, nor is it very cheap

2 Speed ​​means it cannot hit very quickly, but can fight steadily

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZv6hS8YHE9YqbYkvCyKRUXyKaV6h3cxD7D4tWjt5VzGJ/1781934492972.jpg)

Level Up and Power Growth

The most interesting aspect of the BUSY BEAVER card is its improvement according to its level.

 As the level increases:

The number of cards required increases (1 → 5 → 14 → 25 → 40…)

Stats gradually improve

New abilities are unlocked

EST. POWER increases significantly (from 20 to 2415)

This growth shows that this is a “late game scaling unit”. That is, although it may not be very powerful at the beginning, it can gradually become dangerous.

Abilities and the role of combat

The most important part of this card is its ability system. New abilities are added as you level up.

For example:

At the first level, there is a basic ability

At the next level, another offensive/defensive ability is added

Multiple abilities work together at higher levels

These abilities do not limit the card to being just a defensive unit, but it can also do both attack and support.

 During battle, it usually:

Stands as a tank on the front line

Or balances support and damage in the middle line

Gameplay Experience

When I first used BUSY BEAVER, I didn't understand much at first. Because it was low level, it was giving very ordinary performance.

But after playing a few matches, I understood:

It doesn't die easily

It gradually tires out the enemy


It works especially well in long matches. When the opponent wants to win quickly by using strong units, BUSY BEAVER gradually ruins their plans.

Strengths

Some of the main strengths of this card are:

1. Good survivability

7 health and 3 armor put it in a strong position at the beginning.

2. Scaling ability

It becomes much stronger as the level increases.

3. Balanced unit

It can do both tank and support functions.

4.  Ability Combo

Multiple abilities at high levels make it dangerous.

Weaknesses

Although the card is strong, it still has some limitations:

1. Low speed

2. Due to its speed, it often hits late.

2. Weak at the beginning


3. Dependency

It performs well after leveling up.

Strategy

There are some strategies that can be followed when using BUSY BEAVER to get good results:

Use it on the front line if you don't have another tank

It is even stronger if you have a support healer

Works well with slow but powerful team combinations

It is more effective in long battle setups

My personal opinion

In my personal experience, BUSY BEAVER is a patient player’s card. It is a very good card for those who play game patiently and use long-term strategy.

 It may seem simple at first but after playing  few matches, its true power becomes apparent. Especially when it reaches levels 5-8 it can really change  outcome the match.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUB9x5cdD2Pzq5jrStQkNkTiQofDSAv6QQrZgd7LXUb1c/1781934709307.jpg)

Conclusion

Overall, BUSY BEAVER is a balanced and scaling-based card. It acts as a defensive tank on the one hand, and can also make supportive attacks when needed. Although it doesn't get stronger very quickly at the beginning, its power increases a lot as it levels up.

For those who want to build strong units gradually and like the long game, BUSY BEAVER can be a good investment.
