 After confirming everything, the moment of opening the 19 chests began. The chests lined up across the screen looked great. The interest in knowing what was inside each chest was gradually increasing. With each click there was hope  getting something new, and that thrill is what makes opening chests in Splinterlands so enjoyable.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVLjJupKEXRsNYUQSBSN55AHvUL4385y8Y62NUVBp1eJR/1784341904826.jpg)

I am quite satisfied with the rewards I received after opening all chests. Although I did not get any Legendary Cards I still added several useful and valuable items my collection.

Among  rewards I received were—

2 Entry Tokens

1 Rare Scroll

1 Energy

164 Merits

3 Alchemy Potion Charges

3 Legendary Potion Charges

Multiple Monster Cards

1 Rare Card

1 Epic Card

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaacRZGBm6amBCuSQoFKoZLMWy2pvt72fTR5wBVnLN3N8/1784341904935.jpg)

Of particular note among the cards was Stonebind Matron, which is an Epic rarity card. It is always a pleasure to get Epic cards, as they usually have powerful abilities and are useful in the future gameplay.

 I also got two copies of the Oshannus Unmade card. Its not a bad thing to have multiple copies  same card, as they can be combined upgrade  higher levels. This card will become even stronger if you collect more copies in future.

Another notable card was Grim Bonewhip, which is of Rare rarity. Rare cards always help to balance the deck. 

I also found it important to get Potion Charge. Because when I open a chest again in the future, I don't have to buy a new Potion. These charges can be used in the next opening and will increase the chances of getting good rewards again.

Getting 164 Merits is also a good achievement. Merits are very important for buying the Gladius Card Pack from the Guild Shop. So I think these Merits are a good investment for the future.

Getting Entry Tokens is also quite useful. They give you the opportunity to participate in various Tournaments or special events. As a result, not only cards are obtained, but also the possibility of winning bigger rewards in the future.

 Items like Energy and Rare Scrolls will also help you progress in the future. While these may not seem like huge rewards at first glance, they are also worth a lot in the long run.

My biggest takeaway from this entire opening is that there is no guarantee that Minor Chests in Splinterlands will always give huge rewards. However, opening chests by regularly accumulating Glint and using Potions at the right time definitely increases the chances of getting good quality rewards.

Many people expect to get a Legendary Card or Gold Foil every time. But in reality, it depends entirely on RNG (Random Number Generation). So each opening should be seen as a piece of luck. Sometimes you get less, and sometimes one opening can turn the entire game around.

These 19 Minor Chest openings of mine may not have been the luckiest openings, but they can't be called bad at all. I got a balanced reward by combining Epic Cards, Rare Cards, Potion Charges, Entry Tokens, Merits, and other useful resources.

 I plan to open Minor or Major Chests again in the future with Glint. I believe that opening a larger chest will yield better results, especially when there are enough Potions.

Overall, opening 19 Minor Chests for 9,500 Glint was a very enjoyable experience. Not only did I get new cards from this opening, but I was also able to collect Potion Charge, Entry Token, Merits, and other valuable resources for the future. Being patient in Splinterlands and opening Chests with the right strategy may be the most profitable decision in the long run. I hope that a Legendary Gold Foil Card will be added my collection in the next opening. Until then these achievements will enrich my gaming journey and inspire me  move forward with new enthusiasm.

queue.title: Today I leveled up the Deep Delver card – another important upgrade in my Splinterlands journey
queue.body:
Today, I had a great moment playing Splinterlands. Today I finally got the chance level up Deep Delver card that I had been collecting for a long time. The card was already in my collection, but today I collected 14 cards to take it to a stronger level. This upgrade moment was quite a joy for me, because not only did I level up a card, but it also increased my collection power a bit.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXmdZJZcmXqJMB4PdDbicxUvDTSu2kD1M75LGSj4ZqtAY/1786187557830.jpg)

 its practical importance gradually increases it increases in level. Especially at higher levels, the card’s potential becomes even better due the new ability it gains.

Before today’s upgrade, I had a total of 14 copies of Deep Delver.  I brought it to Level 4 by combining these 14 cards. The confirmation shown in the game during the upgrade clearly stated that 14 cards would be combined to create a Level 4 card and there would be 0/15 cards for Level 5. That is, now my next goal is to collect 15 more cards and move towards Level 5.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcVsvWQQRRcqCBZLC13d4M4vTQXTkaoJ4hssD23xvR9Fg/1786187558032.jpg)

There was a kind of excitement working within me while upgrading the cards. Especially when it is a Rare card, I try to move forward with a little calculation. I try to gradually improve the cards that are likely to be used regularly in Battle in the future. Deep Delver is also on that list.

The card in my collection was also at Level 2 and today I took it a few steps further to Level 4. So with today's upgrade, I've actually combined many small collections into one powerful card.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdtvSnnjx4pdkZbxm5uQ2WsyR1wL9Kfm7hvgZSrGezKV/1786187557903.jpg)

For me, the best part of leveling up a card is watching the power of a particular card gradually change. Looking at Deep Delver's stats from Level 1 to Level 8, it's clear that this is not just a normal card. The later levels change in terms of attack, health, and ability. At Level 4, the card gains an additional ability, which is one of the most important things about this upgrade for me.

At Level 4, Deep Delver has an Est. Power of 500 and an Est. PP of around 119.6. This is a big change compared to Level 1.  In other words, as the card's level increases, my Collection Power also increases significantly. This is also a good thing for me, since Collection Power is important in Splinterlands.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSCD6fodzu4FNtPekRJVgmxbTjGt8khqQq1PeNVvVJoGA/1786187557966.jpg)

But Collection Power is not the only thing that matters to me. I want to create cards that will really be useful during Battle.  A card can give a lot of power, but if there is no situation to use it in Battle, then its importance is a little less for me. In the case of Deep Delver, I think that there is an opportunity to use it well in Battle with different rules and mana caps.

Deep Delver is not a low mana card at all because it costs 7 mana. So you have to calculate mana when creating a Battle lineup to use it. However, if you get a combination of attack, armor, health and ability in exchange for 7 mana, it can be a good choice in certain situations. Especially when I have enough mana in hand and have the opportunity to use Death Splinter, then I can consider this card.

Another good thing about Deep Delver for me is its attack.That is, its attack power is better than before when used from the front or in a certain position. Since it has a speed of 2, it is not a very fast unit, but if you use it correctly with other Support or Tank cards, its weakness can be overcome to some extent.

The new Ability I got after going to Level 4 is what actually made today's upgrade even more enjoyable for me. In the picture, you can see that a new green Ability has been added next to the previous Ability. Getting a new Ability means not only a change in numbers, but also new possibilities for using the card during Battle. So I think bringing it up to Level 4 was the right decision.

In Splinterlands, a small Ability on a card can often change the outcome of an entire Battle. Depending on what the opponent's lineup is, what the ruleset of the Battle is, how much mana I have, and what other cards I have—an Ability can become much more effective. So I want to try out how Deep Delver's new Ability works in future Battles.

Another thing I liked about today's upgrade is that it can combine 14 cards into one card. At first, if you collect a lot of the same cards, it may seem like there is no special need to keep them in separate places.  But when those cards can be combined to create a higher level card, the value of the previous collection is understood anew.

However, one aspect of this is that once a card is combined, it cannot be undone. So before combining, I made sure that this moment was right for me to take Deep Delver to Level 4. Since I wanted to use the card in the future and had plans to increase its level, I finally decided to combine it.

Now my next goal is Level 5. As you can see in the picture, a total of 40 cards are needed to go to Level 5, and another 15 cards will be needed from Level 4 to Level 5. Currently, I have a Level 4 Deep Delver and I will have to collect the same card again for Level 5. It may not be very fast, but I intend to collect it gradually.

I usually prefer to collect a card slowly and then upgrade it at the right time rather than improving it as much as possible in one day. Because in Splinterlands, in addition to collecting cards, there are many other things that require resources.  So I think it's better to plan ahead according to my collection.

Today's Level 4 Deep Delver is another important addition to my collection. It may not be my most expensive or most powerful card, but the whole process of collecting it with my own hands, accumulating copies one after another, and finally combining 14 cards to reach Level 4 is special to me.

I think this is where the fun of Splinterlands comes in. Every Battle, every Reward, every Pack Opening, and every new Card Collection slowly builds a larger Collection. Sometimes you get a good card, sometimes you don't get much. Sometimes you get an opportunity to Level Up an existing card. Today is one of those days for me.

Deep Delver is now at Level 4 in my Collection. I want to test it in many more battles ahead. I want to understand what kind of ruleset it performs best in, what tanks it uses to get good results, and how effective the new Ability is—all these things through my own battles.

 Finally, I can say that today's Deep Delver Level Up is a small but happy achievement for me. Combining 14 cards to Level 4, getting a new Ability, and increasing Collection Power—all in all, today's upgrade was quite enjoyable. Now the goal is to gradually collect more Deep Delver and one day take it to Level 5.

My journey in Splinterlands is still ongoing. There are many more cards to collect, many cards to Level Up, and new strategies to test in Battle. Today is Level 4 of Deep Delver, and maybe in the future a new story of such an achievement will be created with another card. These small achievements are actually making my Splinterlands journey more enjoyable.

Although I felt a little pressure at first I did not rush. Because in such a match, losing patience often leads losing control entire game.

queue.title: Decrepit Windseer Analysis, Uses and Strategies a Powerful Elf Card
queue.body:
In the world card games, each card has its own identity history and strategic importance. Some cards are popular simply for their power, while others become valuable players due their special abilities, combinations  long-term use. Decrepit Windseer is one such interesting Elf card, which has the power to change the course of a match if used strategically.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZfHJaqxXBG7gJiJeD2iiWEcy49Ph6apb2bk2uoW8W2UB/1785286526520.jpg)

I recently collected this card and after analyzing its characteristics, battlefield effectiveness and future prospects, I felt that it is not just an ordinary card, but a strategic asset. In this blog, we will discuss the Decrepit Windseer card in detail.

Decrepit Windseer: Card Introduction

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaQKzvJJYRiob21DLkRMBnzfAo45VKmhfr492aS3VXvo1/1785286526610.jpg)

Card Name: Decrepit Windseer
Race: Elf
Mana Cost: 4
Attack: 1
Health: 5
Speed: 3

At first glance, the card's attack power may not seem very high. Many players may consider it weak due to only 1 Attack.  But judging a card by its attack count alone can be a mistake. Decrepit Windseer's true strength lies in its durability, ability to hold position, and strategic use.

Why is Decrepit Windseer important?

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma8yxxVCjR6ga7rDQsu2ATRfhszjFbkHXjmfEjwXVDaPU/1785286526651.jpg)

Sometimes, building a good deck doesn't just require strong attacking cards. A balanced deck also needs cards that can block enemy attacks and support other important cards.

Decrepit Windseer's 5 Health makes him a durable unit. For 4 Mana, he gets a card that cant be easily removed from the field. Especially in early and mid-range battles he can hold off his opponents attacks.

A skilled player knows that its not just important deal damage in every match, but also use right cards right time.

Its relationship with the Elf race

Elf cards are generally known for their strategy, speed, and coordination.  Elf decks often need cards that:

Can survive on the battlefield

Can work well with other Elf cards

Can disrupt the opponent's plans

Decrepit Windseer fits well with this type of strategy.

In an Elf-based deck, it can act as a defensive pillar. While your attacking cards are preparing, this card can buy time from the front.

Card Strengths and Weaknesses

Strengths

1. Good Health

The biggest advantage of this card is its 5 Health. It can stay on the field for a long time compared to many lower Mana cards.

2. Low Mana Cost

A permanent unit is available for 4 Mana cost. This makes the deck's Mana management easier.

3. Strategic Use

This card is not always meant to deal direct damage. It can force your opponent to use their strongest attacks first.

4. Elf Synergy

This can be a valuable addition for players who build Elf-based decks.

Weaknesses

1. Low Attack

With 1 Attack it cant do much damage on its own.

2. Limited to offensive decks

For those who only use offensive decks looking for quick wins, it may seem slow.

3. Needs the right position

To get the most out this card, you need use it at right time and in the right place.

Decrepit Windseer Strategy on the Battlefield

The true value of a card is understood when it is used in a real match.

1. Build an early defense

If your opponent adopts a quick offensive strategy early in the match, Decrepit Windseer can act as a deterrent.

Its 5 Health can absorb the enemy's small attacks and give you time to plan for the next one.

2.  Protecting Important Cards

A deck often has special cards that are key to winning a match. But those cards need time to prepare.

Decrepit Windseer can create that time.

It blocks your opponent from the front, allowing your main attacking cards to work safely.

3. Benefits of Combo

A good deck never relies on a single card. Rather, it is strengthened by combining multiple cards.

It is best to use cards with Decrepit Windseer that:

Can deal extra damage

Can provide support

Can slow down the enemy

Why might it be a good idea to invest in this card?

The price you buy this card for should be considered not only for current use, but also for future potential.

The value of many cards in the game changes over time. Cards that:

Have a specific race (such as Elf)

Good base stats

Useful strategic roles

May be in demand in the future.

 Cards like Decrepit Windseer are not just part of your collection, they can also be considered a strategic asset.

Advice for new players

New players often choose cards based on their Attack alone. But good players know that:

Defense + Strategy + Timing = Victory

Decrepit Windseer teaches new players that each card has a specific role.

With this card, you can learn:

When to be patient

When to defend

When to create an opportunity to attack

Should Decrepit Windseer be in your deck?

The answer to this will depend on your playstyle and deck.

If you

✅ Use an Elf deck

✅ Like a balanced strategy

✅ Want to survive in long matches

✅ Want defensive support


On the other hand, if your deck is completely based on fast attacks, it may not fit your strategy perfectly.

 Future Prospects

In the card game market, cards with special features often become important in the future. New updates, new abilities, or new deck strategies can increase the use of older cards.

Decrepit Windseer's Elf identity and durability make it an attractive card for the future.

Decrepit Windseer is a card that may seem ordinary at first glance, but its true value is revealed upon closer analysis. Its 4 Mana, 5 Health, and Elf attributes make it an effective defensive and strategic card.

It may not be the strongest attacking card, but a good deck requires not only attack, but also balance. With the right planning and the right combinations, Decrepit Windseer can strengthen your gameplay.

As a collector and player, this card is not just a digital asset, but a potential strategic investment.

queue.title: A difficult but instructive victory story at the end of the season
queue.body:
Each rated encounter becomes much more crucial as the season comes to an end. A minor error, a poor choice, or a thoughtless action can alter the match's final result. Since everyone wants improve their position before the season ends, every opponent is playing at their best right now. Therefore, winning a match nowadays involves more than simply chance; it also calls for patience, preparation, expertise, and capacity make right choices at the appropriate moment.

Todays match was also a similar challenge for me. His team was arranged quite strong and each card was arranged in a way that could create big problems for me. From the first round, I had to make every move very thoughtfully. Where to attack, where to build defense, and how much importance to which card—the future of the entire match depended on each decision.

There were several moments during match when it seemed that situation was getting out my control.  But I tried stay calm and not rush. Many times we make wrong decisions under the pressure of the match, but if we are patient and analyze the situation, many good solutions come out. I tried to follow that in this match. I rearranged my plan in every turn and tried to guess the possible moves of the opponent in advance.

I believe that winning is not guaranteed only by having strong cards in the game. Rather, the real skill is using those cards at the right time and with the right strategy. I realized that in this match. There have been moments when I had multiple options in front of me. But not all options were equally good. I chose one that seemed most effective. And the sum of those small decisions ultimately led me to victory.

Another thing taught me to think in a new way. Neglecting the opponents strategy never yields good results. Many times, we focus so much on our own plan that we don't think about what opponent might do. But in this match, I noticed every move opponent.I tried  understand his attack pattern card positions, and possible combinations. I was able change my plan in advance and avoid a lot losses.

This victory taught me another important lesson—giving up is never a solution. There was a time middle match when the situation was not in my favor. I could have lost mentally right then and there. But I knew that if I kept trying until last moment, opportunities might come. That belief helped me survive  match. When the result finally came in my favor, I realized how valuable it is to fight to the end.

At the end of the season, every rating point becomes very valuable. A win can take you a long way, and a loss can take you a long way. So at this time, not only skill but also mental strength is equally important. This match taught me that if you can maintain your confidence even under pressure, it is possible to change even the seemingly impossible situations.

With todays victory, I was able to advance further to Diamond-3 rank. The feeling seeing "Victory" written on screen was truly different.  At that moment, I felt that patience focus hard work I had put in throughout match had paid off. The most important thing I learned from this match is that you cannot always win with strength alone without a plan. Patience observation timely decisions and mentality learning from your mistakes make player better. Every match teaches you something new those lessons are useful in future difficult matches.

I think that a good player never plays just to win. He tries to learn something from every match. Because the learning process never ends. Todays match made me realize that I am still learning a lot there is still room for improvement. And this realization inspires me move forward.

There may be many more tough matches waiting before the end season. I have face stronger opponents. Maybe we will not win every match. But this experience today has made me believe that with proper preparation patience and persistent efforts even tough challenges can be overcome.

I believe that every tough match teaches us something new, and those lessons form the basis for great success one day. So no matter how tough the battle ahead, I will try give my best in every match, learn from my mistakes use every experience stepping stone for my own improvement.
